answer_1.quote: We propose a new approach to overgenerate and select admissible summaries, which allows a summarizer to juggle multiple objectives and strike a good balance between them.

answer_2.quote: We report R-1, R-2 and R-L F 1 -scores that respectively measure the overlap of unigrams, bigrams, and longest common subsequences between system and reference summaries.

answer_4.quote: We recruit human evaluators to judge the quality of each summary given its source text.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator is asked to answer three yes-no questions. They include (a) has the summary successfully convey the main points of the source text? (b) is the summary truthful to the meaning of the source text? (c) is the summary grammatical?
